destinations.tagline: Goa's sacred temples, far from the beaches.
destinations.intro: Goa's sacred temples, far from the beaches.
destinations.about: A 3 days heritage route through Nageshi, Mangeshi and Shanta Durga, Saptakoteshwar, Bhairoba Goa.
destinations.food: Local food traditions can be added to the route during planning.
destinations.architecture: Begin with two of Goa's best-known temples and their distinctive architecture. Spend the day on the history and story of this ancient Shiva temple. Visit the local shrine, learn about village deity traditions, and wrap up the trip.
destinations.local_stories: Goa's sacred temples, far from the beaches.

destinations.tagline: Walk through the ruins of an empire.
destinations.intro: Walk through the ruins of an empire.
destinations.about: A 3-4 days heritage route through Vijayanagar, Kishkindha, Jain Prabhag, A slower day.
destinations.food: Local food traditions can be added to the route during planning.
destinations.architecture: Explore the royal and sacred centres of the old capital. Cross to the legendary landscape linked to the Ramayana. Discover Hampi's lesser-known Jain heritage. Revisit favourite sites, sunrise viewpoints, and photography.
destinations.local_stories: Walk through the ruins of an empire.

destinations.tagline: Temples, shores, and traditions along the Karnataka coast.
destinations.intro: Temples, shores, and traditions along the Karnataka coast.
destinations.about: A 4-5 days heritage route through Karwar, Gokarna, Murudeshwar, Udupi, Karkala.
destinations.food: Local food traditions can be added to the route during planning.
destinations.architecture: Start at the port town and its coastal history. Visit the pilgrimage town and its temples. See the seaside Shiva temple. Explore the temple town and its famous food traditions. Finish with the Jain monuments and heritage of the town.
destinations.local_stories: Temples, shores, and traditions along the Karnataka coast.

destinations.tagline: Deccan history, from sultanates to the Nizams.
destinations.intro: Deccan history, from sultanates to the Nizams.
neighbourhoods: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, then return to Pune
destinations.about: A 4 days heritage route through Solapur, Latur, Hyderabad, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, then return to Pune.
destinations.food: Local food traditions can be added to the route during planning.
destinations.architecture: Begin with the fort and the region's old trade town. Continue through the heart of Marathwada. Spend the day on the monuments and old city of the Nizams. Close with the caves, forts, and tombs of the old Deccan capital.
destinations.local_stories: Deccan history, from sultanates to the Nizams.

destinations.tagline: The Maratha heartland, town by town.
destinations.intro: The Maratha heartland, town by town.
destinations.about: A 2 days (please confirm) heritage route through Pune, Wai and Satara, Kolhapur, Narsobachi Wadi and Karad.
destinations.food: Local food traditions can be added to the route during planning.
destinations.architecture: Start with the old city, then travel to the ghats and hill towns of the Krishna valley. Visit the temple city, the riverside shrine, and end at the confluence town of Karad.
destinations.local_stories: The Maratha heartland, town by town.

destinations.about: A 3-4 days heritage route through Badami, Aihole, Pattadakal, A flexible day.
destinations.food: Local food traditions can be added to the route during planning.
destinations.architecture: Explore the cave temples and the old Chalukyan capital. See the early experimental temples, often called the cradle of temple architecture. Finish at the UNESCO-listed temple complex. Revisit sites or explore nearby villages.
